'''Andrew Howard''' was listed as '''Tournament Support Advocate''' on the early swccgpc.com Advocate Council, succeeding [[John Arendt]] in that role.<ref name="swccgpc2002home">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021106101746/http://www.swccgpc.com/ The SWCCG Player's Committee], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 6 November 2002)</ref><ref name="council2002">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021209221742/http://www.swccgpc.com/council.htm Advocate Council], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 9 December 2002)</ref>

This page is a '''fan encyclopedia''' stub.

== Documented PC role and turnover ==

* '''~November 2002:''' Homepage news notes [[Josh Radke|Josh "Red 84" Radke]] (Player Relations Advocate) welcoming Andrew Howard as Tournament Support Advocate, replacing former Tournament Advocate John Arendt.<ref name="swccgpc2002home" />
* '''~December 2002:''' Listed as Tournament Support Advocate on council.htm.<ref name="council2002" />
* By the June 2004 council.htm capture, '''Mitch Velasco''' is listed as Tournament Support Advocate (Howard not named there).<ref name="council2004">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040603222905/http://www.swccgpc.com/council.htm Advocate Council], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 June 2004)</ref>

Howard was '''not''' on Decipher's January 2002 six-person first Advocates list.<ref name="pc1">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020611042314/http://decipher.com/starwars/playerscommittee1.html The Star Wars Players' Committee], decipher.com (Wayback, 11 June 2002)</ref>
